messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — one of the H100 racks is scheduled to arrive this Thursday (3/26). We need owners for: racking, PDU labeling, NIC staging, and initial node burn-in. Can volunteers claim? I'll coordinate with shipping.
Maria Gomez: Procurement update: carrier delay resolved, ETA 3/26 10–2pm. Packing slip ID 5XK-392. I'll be onsite for sign-off until noon.
Ops Bot: Shipping notice: Tracking 1Z9999EXAMPLE delivered to DC-East on 2026-03-26 11:47. Special handling: two crates, forklift required.
Samir Patel: I can cover racking (physical install) and power metering. Need confirmation of PDU breakers — are we still using 30A C19 per rack?
Jia Wu: Confirmed: 30A C19. Also need to plan for BMC firmware updates pre-networking. Can someone pick up BMC staging?
Devin Marshall: I'll take NIC staging and VLAN mapping. Also need a heads-up if Dedicated capacity reservations should be updated — will customers be shifted to staging capacity?
Leo Anders: From platform side, schedule looks like: post-install smoke tests + canary on Mon. Suggest reserving 20% of the rack for canary traffic first. @Devin — can you update reservations to reflect that?
Maria Gomez: Adding on: QA wants node burn-in 48h with memtester/prime95 equivalent. Test runner image at `gcr.io/redwood/ci/node-burn:stable`.
Samir Patel: For burn-in, use this command on the test node:
```
./burnin.sh --hours 48 --cpu 32 --mem 128G --log /tmp/burn.log
```
Jia Wu: I'll do the BMC/firmware chain: IPMI baseline, firmware 2.3.1, set KVM access. Ping me when rack is powered.
Alex Chen: Owners so far: racking - Samir, PDU/power - Samir, NIC/VLAN - Devin, BMC/firmware - Jia, shipping/sign-off - Maria, canary coord - Leo. Does that cover gaps?
Devin Marshall: Yep. I'll also open a dedicated reservation ticket — linking it to ticket INFRA-4621 and set capacity label `canary-20pct`.
Leo Anders: I'll schedule the canary run and prep dashboards. One ask: can infra expose early token-level cost telemetry to the console for the canary customers? small sample only.
Samir Patel: We need a quick checklist for onsite crew. Draft below; volunteers flag additions:
- Uncrate + check for physical damage
- Rack into slots 10–12
- Install rails and cage
- Connect PDUs, label outlets
- Cable management (10G cross-connects)
- Power on sequencing
- Verify BMC network reachability
- Run burn-in
Maria Gomez: Add: confirm serial numbers match packing slip; photograph and upload to JIRA ticket INFRA-4621.
Alex Chen: Cool — if no objections, I'll update the milestone tracker. Next milestone: `rack-in-place` (3/26), `burn-complete` (3/28), `canary-live` (3/30). I'll ping again with exact times.
Devin Marshall: FYI I've started the reservation but need a confirmed rack ID to finalize—@Samir can you confirm slot numbers after racking?
Samir Patel: Will do. ETA to confirm slots: 3/26 @ 14:30.
Ops Bot: Reminder: Please fill in the oncall contact sheet: https://redwood.example/ops/oncall — required for site access.
Jia Wu: One more dependency — networking needs VLAN 2101 provisioned in DC-East. @neteng can you queue it?
NetEng Bot: VLAN 2101 requested by Devin Marshall. ETA 6 hours.
Alex Chen: Great. Thanks all. I'll post a short summary in #eng-sre and update INFRA-4621 when done. :thumbsup:
